channel.title: Sajjad's Engineering Academy — Engineering Guides
channel.description: Practical engineering guides for maintenance, reliability, HVAC, electrical systems, utilities and industrial troubleshooting.

item.title: FMEA for Maintenance Engineers
item.description: Identify failure modes, effects, causes, controls and prioritized maintenance actions before failures recur.

item.title: Preventive Maintenance
item.description: Build a risk-based preventive maintenance program that targets real equipment failure modes.

item.title: 5-Why Root Cause Analysis
item.description: Move from failure symptoms to evidence-based root causes and corrective actions using a structured 5-Why approach.

item.title: Professional PPM Checklist
item.description: Turn OEM guidance, equipment history and measurable inspection criteria into practical technician PPM tasks.

item.title: Bearing Failure Causes
item.description: Diagnose lubrication, contamination, alignment, installation and electrical bearing damage.

item.title: Steam Trap Fundamentals
item.description: Understand steam-trap types, failed-open and failed-closed symptoms, inspection approaches and energy implications.

item.title: Compressor Oil Carryover
item.description: Diagnose compressor, separator, dryer, filter and drain causes of oil carryover in compressed-air systems.

item.title: MTBF Explained
item.description: Understand the MTBF formula, examples, limitations and practical use in reliability engineering.

item.title: MTTR Explained
item.description: Measure and reduce average equipment repair duration while keeping repair-time definitions consistent.

item.title: VFD Fundamentals
item.description: Learn variable-frequency-drive operation, speed control, common trips and structured maintenance troubleshooting.

item.title: AHU Troubleshooting
item.description: Separate HVAC load, airflow, chilled-water, controls and fan/VFD problems using a structured AHU diagnostic approach.
